Agent Name: Verification_Expert
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: They selected the final hikes based mainly on TripAdvisor ratings/review counts from general attraction pages and did not verify the key constraint that each hike was recommended by at least three different people with kids. This led to including non-hike/general attractions (e.g., Old Faithful, Mammoth Terraces, West Thumb) and omitting correct hikes (e.g., Trout Lake Trail, Artist Point, Lone Star Geyser, Storm Point Trail) that satisfy the criteria.
